description: This file defines the interface ILifecycleParticipant<TLifecycleObservable> within the Orleans namespace, providing a contract for objects that can participate in lifecycle events and act as signals for lifecycle participation.

classes.name: ILifecycleParticipant
classes.description: An interface that enables objects to participate in lifecycle events, parameterized by a type of lifecycle observable.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Method to add an observer as a participant in the lifecycle.
